info.title: VeloxDev.Cli
info.description: Headless VeloxDev workflow host and stdio MCP server: load an archive and its component assemblies, inspect and edit the graph through the library's own commands, compile, execute and save.

x-inspectra.cliParsedTitle: VeloxDev.Cli — a headless workflow runner and a stdio MCP server.

options.name: --archive
options.description: Workflow document produced by the library's serializer. Required.

options.name: --manifest
options.description: Archive manifest. Defaults to <archive>.manifest.json when that file exists.

options.name: --assembly
options.description: A dependency assembly to load before the document is read. Repeatable.

options.name: --strict-plugin-versions
options.description:
Refuse to load a plugin whose VeloxDev.Core / Core.Extension reference has a
different major version than the host. Default is to load it and warn.

options.name: --single-archive
options.description:
Serve exactly one document for the life of the process: LoadArchive is
refused, so runtime IDs remain stable. Start a new process per archive.

options.name: --no-assembly-copy
options.description:
Load dependency DLLs from their source directory instead of a per-process
copy. The default copy keeps the project's build output unlocked.

options.name: --no-run-csv
options.description:
Do not write execution results to tasks/<task>/runs/<timestamp>.csv.
The CSV export is on by default.

options.name: --root-type
options.description:
Concrete tree type the document was serialized from, when it was not
TreeDefaultViewModel (e.g. Demo.ViewModels.TreeViewModel). The manifest may
carry the same value as "rootType".

options.name: --allow-execution
options.description:
Expose the tools that run node business code (mcp mode only).
--in-process-execution Run node code inside the MCP server instead of a child process. Faster and
enables the handle/pause/status tools, but a hanging or crashing node takes
the server down with it.

options.name: --redirect-on-error
options.description:
Host-level fallback for a node that reports an error but does not implement
IRedirectable: re-run from this upstream node. 0-based ListNodes index.

options.name: --checkpoint-file
options.description:
Keep run checkpoints in this file instead of memory, so a continuation survives
the process. In-process execution only.

options.name: --log-file
options.description:
Append every run's log lines to this file. The run result then names it as
logFile instead of relying on the in-memory tail.

options.name: --workspace
options.description:
Restrict every file path this process reads or writes (archive, manifest,
assemblies, checkpoint, log, SaveArchive) to this existing directory.

options.name: --max-concurrent-runs
options.description:
How many isolated worker processes may run at once (default 2; 0 = unlimited).
Excess calls wait for a slot.

options.name: --worker-kill-grace-ms
options.description:
Extra time after a run's timeout before the server kills the worker (default
5000). Tests and tightly controlled hosts can lower it.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show this text.

options.name: --start
options.description: Index of the compile entry node, as listed by ListNodes. Required.

options.name: --node-result
options.description:
Use the terminal role: compute the node at --start (and its ancestor cone)
instead of running the whole chain from it.

options.name: --output-tree
options.description:
Write the post-run graph to this path. The result names it as stateFile; the
MCP client can adopt it with LoadArchive after an isolated run.

options.name: --seed
options.description: Optional seed payload written to the session's Data.

options.name: --timeout-ms
options.description:
Optional timeout. Omit to wait for the run to end.
The archive manifest is a small JSON file:
{
"assemblies": [ "lib/MyNodes.dll" ],
"allowExecution": false
}
Assembly paths are resolved relative to the manifest and may not escape its directory.
Loading an assembly runs its code, so both the manifest and --assembly are privileged input.
